entities.title: MCP tools
entities.summary: The thirteen tools an agent calls: navigation and search answered from the index, git history, a guarded command passthrough, a terse view of a C# file and a way to report what was missing.
entities.purpose: Holds one class per tool behind the ITool contract, with the helpers they share: argument parsing and schemas (Args), root:path references (RootSet), globs, the token-budgeted output builder, the run allowlist and the external regex fallback. Each tool returns compact text and fills in a CallInfo for the usage log.
boundaries: The tools read the index (src/Index/) and the stored analysis (src/Analysis/, through Engine and Store); they never write the store except through RootIndex.
Dispatch, timing and logging of a call are src/Mcp/; the tools only fill in CallInfo.
The view tool reads its file from disk and builds the view with src/View/; it does not use the index.
Paths an agent passes are resolved through Root.Resolve (src/Root.cs), except where backlog.json says otherwise.
